# nico_dpu_extension_service (Resource)

DPU Extension Service allows users to run custom services in the DPUs of their Instances. Currently K8s pods are the only supported service type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_dpu_extension_service" "example" {
  name                           = "name-value"
  service_type                   = "service-type-value"
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  data                           = "data-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) Deployment spec for the DPU Extension Service
- `name` (String) Name for the DPU Extension Service. Must be unique for a given Tenant
- `service_type` (String) Type of the DPU Extension Service
- `site_id` (String) ID for the Site the DPU Extension Service belongs to

### Optional

- `credentials` (Attributes) Credentials to download resources specified in DPU Extension Service data (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `description` (String) Optional description for the DPU Extension Service
- `dpu_extension_service_id` (String) Path parameter: dpu_extension_service_id.
- `observability` (Attributes) Observability configuration for the DPU Extension Service version (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observability))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when this version of the DPU Extension Service was created
- `has_credentials` (Boolean) Indicates whether this version was created with credentials
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `version` (String) Current version of the DPU Extension Service

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String) Password for the registry. Must be specified if registry URL is specified
- `registry_url` (String) URL for the registry the credential should be used for
- `username` (String) Username for the registry. Must be specified if registry URL is specified


<a id="nestedatt--observability"></a>
### Nested Schema for `observability`

Read-Only:

- `configs` (Attributes List) Observability configurations to apply to the service version (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observability--configs))

<a id="nestedatt--observability--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `observability.configs`

Read-Only:

- `logging` (Attributes) Logging configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observability--configs--logging))
- `name` (String) Optional name of the service or component being monitored
- `prometheus` (Attributes) Prometheus scrape configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observability--configs--prometheus))

<a id="nestedatt--observability--configs--logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `observability.configs.logging`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Path to the log file to collect


<a id="nestedatt--observability--configs--prometheus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `observability.configs.prometheus`

Read-Only:

- `scrape_interval_seconds` (Number) How often Prometheus should scrape the endpoint
